reviews.title: Gets extremely hot, 110C
reviews.comment: Works great, but gets very hot. 110C easily when video encoding or other memory intensive tasks. When it reach that temperature, it starts do errors. Please make sure you do a good ventilation or cooling.
reviews.author: DS

reviews.title: Used to upgrade UGREEN NAS - no compatibility issues
reviews.comment: Installed without any issues in my Ugreen DXP2800 NAS. Allowed me to upgrade from 8gb. Matched the speed that was supported at 4800mhz and has been running stable for about 4 months now.
reviews.author: Colby R.
